attribution.changes: Converted to ONNX from Yahoo's original Caffe files (nsfw_model/deploy.prototxt and nsfw_model/resnet_50_1by2_nsfw.caffemodel at the commit in source_url) by Faro's crates/faro-detect/models/opennsfw/convert.py: each BatchNorm and Scale layer is folded into the convolution before it. The weights are not retrained or fine-tuned. Quantized to int8 with ONNX Runtime 1.19.2 (QDQ format; stages 2 and 3 in int8, the stem and the classifier head in float), calibrated on synthetic, non-explicit images.
